corrected_content.problem:
Given that a curve is defined parametrically as
$$
\displaystyle x = t^{2} - 4t, y = t^{2}, t ∈ (- ∞, ∞),
$$
determine the range of $x$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Complete the square:
$$x=t^2-4t=(t-2)^2-4\ge-4.$$
The lower bound is attained at $t=2$.
